# Tetiana Kotolup — IT Specialist (AI automation & full-stack development)

> Tetiana Kotolup is an IT specialist based in Brno, Czech Republic. She builds n8n workflow automations, AI voice agents, Telegram AI bots and full-stack web applications with OpenAI and Anthropic Claude, Node.js, TypeScript, React and PostgreSQL/Supabase. She works in Czech, English, Ukrainian and Russian and is open to full-time roles in Brno, Prague or remote, and to freelance projects.
